name: task_start
description: Start a task from a contract: write contract.json to the gate's state directory, create the task and move it to preparing. Refused when the state directory already holds a contract.

forbidden_effects.description: Declared only; the gate does not enforce it.

scope.description: Path prefixes the candidate may change.

name: candidate_observe
description: Report the candidate under test. A new identity marks every earlier receipt stale. In state repairing this also ends the repair round and returns the task to verifying. The identity is caller-asserted.

provenance.description: Who observed the candidate; default mcp-caller.

name: receipt_record
description: Record one check result for a criterion, bound to the current candidate. Caller-asserted: the server does not observe the command, and the receipt is stored and journaled as mcp-asserted.

name: finding_raise
description: Raise an open finding against the current candidate. An open high or critical finding refuses acceptance.

name: repair_request
description: Spend one repair round and move the task to repairing. When the budget is already spent the task becomes budget_exhausted and the request is refused.

name: accept_try
description: Ask the gate to accept the current candidate: every mandatory criterion needs a current receipt with exit 0, every changed path must be in scope, and no high or critical finding may be open. On success the task is ready_for_review.

name: task_complete
description: Complete a task that is ready_for_review; the gate checks the evidence again first.

name: task_state
description: Return the checkpoint, the receipt status per criterion and the receipt claims the gate rejected. No transition.
